name: baseline-gemini-top3
description: Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite alone (the first link of today's production chain), paced under the free-tier limit of 15 requests per minute. No fallback, so every answer comes from Gemini. Summaries by DeepSeek (identical across configs). Same as baseline-gemini but only the 3 closest projects per article are sent to the model (maxProjects 3). Prompts for the kept pairs are identical, so it replays from the cache.
